# /test with data pack instances: every block based outcome (pass, fail, timeout, missing/duplicate start block, missing accept
# block, log block), rotation and padding, an old-version structure that runs the structure data fixers, retries, optional and
# manual-only tests, other dimensions and test environments (gt = default environment, ge = environments).
#   scripts/command-diff.sh crates/mc-game/tests/fixtures/commands_corpus/gametest_pack.txt
# The run time of a test (`passed! (3ms / 2gameticks)`) is the only non-deterministic output. Every test runs alone: our server lays several tests of
# one run out in a different order than vanilla, and vanilla starts several batches in an order that differs between runs.
!datapack gametest/gtpack
!datapack gametest/gepack
!ignore passed! \(
!mask (\d+)ms
# the summary lines the bots receive are not compared for any test (vanilla's ops sometimes miss the summary of a passing test; the
# console copy `log| System chat: ...` of every summary stays compared), and the bots sometimes miss the failure of a test on its first
# tick (two recordings of the same file differ in exactly these lines)
!ignore ^Bot\| .*(Game Test complete! |All required tests passed|commands\.test\.summary)
!ignore ^Bot0?\| .*(Test structure missing Start block|Too many Start blocks)
datapack list enabled
test run gt:pass
!ticks 40 show
test run gt:fail
!ticks 40 show
test run gt:log
!ticks 40 show
test run gt:timeout
!ticks 40 show
test run gt:rot
!ticks 40 show
test run gt:no_start
!ticks 40 show
test run gt:two_start
!ticks 40 show
test run gt:no_accept
!ticks 40 show
test run gt:old_structure
!ticks 40 show
test run gt:nether
!ticks 40 show
test run gt:manual
!ticks 40 show
test run gt:optional_fail
!ticks 40 show
test run gt:flaky
!ticks 40 show
test run gt:flaky_pass
!ticks 40 show
test run ge:setup
!ticks 40 show
test run ge:weather
!ticks 40 show
test run ge:missing_function
!ticks 40 show
!known locate lists the instances in a different order: vanilla searches the point-of-interest storage, ours scans the loaded chunks
test locate gt:*
test locate ge:*
test clearall
